phase_1.description: Mellow Fellow is a hemp-derived cannabinoid brand founded in 2021 by a PhD chemist, pharmacist (JJ Coombs, Pharm.D.), and cannabis entrepreneur. Operating through Arvida Labs in South Florida, the company specializes in proprietary cannabinoid blends including Delta 8, Delta 9, Delta 10, THCp, THCv, HHC, and live resin products sold as vapes, disposables, edibles, gummies, and tinctures. The brand positions itself on pharmacist-formulated, lab-tested products with mood-based branding (Creativity Blend, Tranquility Blend, Euphoria Blend, etc.) targeting consumers seeking federally-compliant alternative cannabinoid experiences.
phase_1.headquarters: South Florida (Hallandale/Pompano Beach area); operations through Arvida Labs
phase_1.business_model: Direct-to-consumer e-commerce (mellowfellow.fun) plus wholesale distribution to smoke shops, vape stores, CBD retailers nationwide. Revenue from proprietary branded cannabinoid products manufactured in-house through Arvida Labs. Ships to 40+ states with compliance geo-blocking. Operates within 2018 Farm Bill framework for hemp-derived cannabinoids (<0.3% Delta 9 THC). Part of 'Good Fellows' coalition with Urb, Zombi, and Pushin P's brands supporting Florida hemp advocacy.

recent_news.headline: RICO Civil Lawsuit Filed - CCT Sciences v. Mellow Fellow Fun LLC & Arvida Labs
recent_news.significance: Competitor CCT Sciences sued Mellow Fellow and Arvida Labs under Florida's Civil Remedies for Criminal Practices Act alleging products exceed legal THC limits, false lab results, and selling marijuana disguised as hemp. Lawsuit alleges money laundering and unfair competitive advantage. Ongoing litigation represents significant legal/reputational risk.

recent_news.headline: Good Fellows Coalition - Florida Hemp Advocacy
recent_news.significance: Mellow Fellow joined consortium with Urb, Zombi, Pushin P's to fight Florida SB 1698 hemp restrictions. Successfully lobbied against bills that would have banned intoxicating hemp products in Florida in both 2024 and 2025 legislative sessions. Coalition released co-branded products to fund advocacy efforts through Florida Healthy Alternatives Association (FHAA).

recent_news.headline: Federal Hemp THC Ban Statement
recent_news.significance: Mellow Fellow and Arvida Labs issued joint statement regarding newly enacted federal provision banning most intoxicating hemp-derived THC products, signaling potential major business disruption.
